name: An empty load list is handled without a crash or an invented schedule

planSteps.description: Open the app and wait for the initial solve.
Remove all three loads one at a time using the 'x' button on each row, waiting briefly between each.
Verify the page stays stable: no error appears, no crash occurs, and no schedule is invented for zero loads.
Verify a new load row appears with a default energy of 2 kWh and that the ribbon still renders.
